newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - June 20.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - June 20.

text.p: Following is a summary of major political and business stories in local newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Shanghai. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.

- SHANGHAI SECURITIES NEWS - The listing of Chinese mainland companies in Hong Kong is reaching a peak with three firms to be listed as H shares on the Hong Kong stock exchange next week, bringing the total number of such listings to 32.
- Commentary says recent official crackdown measures on the stock markets signal Beijing's determination to cut off illegal money supply to the markets and protect the interests of retail investors.
- BUSINESS NEWS - Shanghai customs office recently uncovered a smuggling case involving 200 cars worth 70 million yuan, the largest car smuggling case uncovered in Shanghai so far.
- China has build over 8,000 high buildings of 20 stories or more since the early 1980s with skyscraper construction technology now approaching world standards.
